title: Reinstatement of a TRICARE Select Enrollment Ended for Nonpayment
content:
**Enrollment rule.** A nonpayment disenrollment of a **TRICARE Select** enrollment is reversed only through an Enrollment Reinstatement Review. The enrollment is reinstated only when an Enrollment Reinstatement Review case for this enrollment is decided overturned and every past-due installment through the current period has a payment posted. Reinstatement restores coverage from the day after the old paid-through date with no gap and claim lines denied for the gap are reversed and adjudicated again.

## Conditions, read from the records

| Condition | Record | Tied to |
|---|---|---|
| an Enrollment Reinstatement Review case is decided overturned | the review case in Appeals and Grievances | the case names this Select enrollment as its subject |
| every past-due installment through the current period has a payment posted | the enrollment's fee account | payments posted against those installment charges |

Both conditions must hold; neither alone reinstates the enrollment.

## Effect (hypothetical)

An enrollment disenrolled for nonpayment with a paid-through date of 2026-03-31 that is reinstated is restored from 2026-04-01 with no break; lines for April care denied while the enrollment stood ended are reversed and adjudicated again.
